en: In Sirach 18, a long human life reaches how many years?
In Sirach 18, a grudging gift makes which body parts smart?
In Sirach 20, favors and gifts blind which body parts?
In Sirach 20, forced justice is likened to which man lusting for a girl?
In Sirach 21, to a fool education is like fetters on which body part?
In Sirach 21, instruction to the wise is like an ornament of which metal?
In Sirach 22, things set on an open height cannot withstand what?
In Sirach 23, before which group is an adulterous woman brought?
In Sirach 25, a sandy hill is hard on the feet of which people?
In Sirach 26, who is happy for having a good wife?
In Sirach 29, charity fights for you better than a shield and which weapon?
In Sirach 29, becoming surety shakes prosperous men like what on the sea?
In Sirach 32, when the banquet ends, where should a guest go quickly?
In Sirach 32, music with good wine is like a seal of which gem?
In Sirach 33, people in God's hands are like clay in whose hands?
In Sirach 34, which practice for sins is useless if one sins again?
